list.expr: changes(sum by (job,instance) (group by (job,instance, os_description) (target_info{job=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance", os_description!=""}))[$__interval:1m] offset -$__interval) > 1
list.name: OS or kernel change

targets.expr:
100 * (1 - avg by (job,instance) (sum by (job,instance, cpu) (system_cpu_utilization_ratio{job=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance", state=~"idle|wait"})))
or
100 * (1 - avg by (job,instance) (sum by (job,instance, cpu) (system_cpu_utilization{job=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance", state=~"idle|wait"})))

panels.description: Top 25. Share of CPU time spent working: not idle, and not waiting for I/O.

)
